title: The 3-Second Hook Framework
deck: 80% of the decision to watch an ad happens in the first 3 seconds. Four proven hook patterns and a first-frame checklist can as much as double video CTR.
summary: The 3-second hook is the design of the first 3 seconds that stops the scroll. Pick one of four patterns — UGC-style, problem-statement, result-first, or social-proof citation — and build the first frame around it.

rows: A person speaks straight to camera in direct address
Show the target's pain point via captions + skit
Put the Before/After or end result in the first cut

content.html: All 7 must be visible in the video's 0-second still (first frame = thumbnail):

items: A human face or strong visual impact (plain UI screens don't work)
One line of large caption text (4–6 words)
Captions placed inside the network's safe zone
The message reads with sound off (muted autoplay is the default)
At least one motion element moving against the scroll direction
Designed to not instantly read as an ad (feels like content; avoid "ad copy" tone)
Hook Rate = 3-second views / impressions — varies by network, ~25–35% average on TikTok
Hold Rate = 50% completes / 3-second views — how well the mid-section delivers
CTR = clicks / impressions — the final decision metric
Monitor all three weekly in the network's video analytics report. Replace any video with Hook Rate under 25% immediately.

content.title: Hook Rate is high but CTR is low
content.html: The hook pulls people in but the message/CTA is weak. Strengthen the core value proposition mid-video and end with a clear CTA (install-prompt screen) in the last 3 seconds.

content.title: UGC-style credibility problems
content.html: If it reads as a professional actor, effectiveness drops ~30%. Use real user interviews or micro-influencers. Deliberately lowering the production quality can make it feel like a "real video".

content.title: Hook rotation cadence
content.html: Running the same hook for 3+ weeks causes creative fatigue — CTR drops 30%+. Keep 3 variants of the same concept and rotate every 2 weeks.
